integrity: The exact vertex partition and polynomial factorization furnish an all-dimensional written proof; conditional bounded-variable laws give Gaussian limits. Reproducible finite exact computations check examples but do not replace the general proof. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
limitations: The exact squared Euclidean chord polynomial and conditional three-scale limit hold for anchored coordinate star signed-chain polytopes only; changing to the zero-sum graph metric changes the distances. Previously known face counts, volume, diameter and basic vertex layering are credited, not claimed as original; historical priority is not globally certified.
title: Three macroscopic Euclidean chord scales in star signed-chain polytopes
